DALTON, Ga., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (

)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—today announced that its Century Complete brand is now selling new single-family homes at Old Praters Mill in Dalton, Ga., with pricing starting from the upper $200s. The community will celebrate with a Grand Opening on Saturday, Oct. 17, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.
Learn more, explore available homes, and RSVP for the Grand Opening at
At the Grand Opening, attendees can tour move-in ready homes, meet the Century Complete team, and learn about home savings and financing available through affiliate lender, Inspire Home Loans®.

"Century Complete is built around making new construction attainable, and Old Praters Mill is a clear example of that in Northwest Georgia," said Regional President Cliff Niederpruem. "Starting from the upper $200s, buyers get a choice of three floor plans with a full set of impressive features, plus easy access to I-75 and regional job hubs."

Old Praters Mill offers three one- and two-story floor plans, with 1,562 to 1,965 square feet, 3 to 4 bedrooms, and 2 to 2.5 bathrooms. Every plan includes a 2-car garage, and every home features a modern, open-concept layout and designer features.
